expectation_correction.correction: Supersede the earlier output-response shorthand D_F=R-N with D_F=R-M, where M is the new same-worker native sham. The historical N output is N_old and its replay discrepancy M-N_old is measured separately. The original incoming source N1 remains the exact saved native latent in both the source intervention and RMS(P1-N1) normalizer; N1 is not the new output M. Both forecast rank/alignment directions remain unchanged.

original_expectations.action_on_miss: Preserve actual vectors, tails, rank/sign misses and continuation; revise interpretation without refitting the profile.
branches_per_context: same-value native N1 latent replacement sham

capture.every_transition: Complete manifest, receipt, field hashes and64 fixed witnesses; descriptor-only unless retained
capture.full_landmarks: locals0,5,25,26,27 at logicalpass1; local27 at logicalpasses2,3; all four branch starts and terminal consumers

original_expectations.continuation: Native logical passes1,2,3 and actual native VAE; no encodes, noise draws or mathematical recomputation

expectations.definition: D_G=P-Q, D_F=R-N; report undefined cosine when either vector is zero

measurements: Full signed D_G,D_F and their difference, native-response-normalized RMS, cosine and tails at pass1 landmarks
RMS(D_F)/RMS(P1-N1), labelled a finite response ratio, not a Jacobian or global sensitivity bound

original_expectations.mechanics: Typed source/checkpoint/clock/layout identity and actual instrument execution are required. Baseline mismatches remain explicit instrument diagnostics; no scientific quality gate or automatic retry.
original_expectations.scope: New controlled native consumer branches from known selected sources. Original P/N/Q outcomes already observed. P continuations were sealed previously; no fresh-seed replication or general semantic claim.
original_expectations.source_boundary: Original native committed N1 at logical step1/project, with all working fields reset

response_contract.RGB_scope: Fixed-coordinate decoded output contrasts. P_RGB-R_RGB is decoded implementation disagreement from the predicted starting state; R_RGB-M_RGB is the decoded native response; M_RGB-N_old_RGB is historical end-to-end replay difference including any VAE difference. These are not additive latent mechanisms or unique object/color responsibilities.

definitions.M: New same-worker native N1 same-value latent sham continuation
definitions.N_old: Original historical native trajectory and image
definitions.P: Original previously sealed mathematical trajectory from predicted incoming P1
definitions.Q: Previously computed G1(N1), matched-input mathematical pass1
definitions.R: New same-worker native P1 latent replacement continuation

response_contract.exclusions: No new seeds, fitting, numerical-profile tuning, Jacobian/global sensitivity or universal semantic claim.
response_contract.expectation_scope_clarification: Both original rank/alignment expectations refer to paired D_F=R-M. Their directions remain unchanged. Original sources/P/N/Q outcomes are known; M/R targets are uncomputed.
response_contract.historical_replay_diagnostic: M-N_old is retained separately. Numerical disagreement alone does not suppress R; actual source/checkpoint/closure/clock/implementation mismatch remains an integrity issue.
response_contract.norm_accounting: Retain all three squared norms and all three signed pairwise twice-dot terms for the historical identity. Do not assign independent causal percentages.
response_contract.response_error: E_response=D_G-D_F; relative RMS uses RMS(D_F), undefined for zero denominator
